en.hubeali:
And from him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad and Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said, 
‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The group of people come to me, so they want to hear your<sup>asws</sup> Ahadeeth from me, so I get tired and am not strong’.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So read a Hadeeth upon them from its beginning, and a Hadeeth from its middle, and a Hadeeth from its end’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from him from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abdallah ibn Sinan who has said the following. “I said to (Imam) abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.), ‘People come to me and they listen to the Ahadith that I narrate to them from you. I become tired and weak.’”
The Imam said, “Narrate to them a Hadith from the beginning and one from the middle and one from the end.”
